name: ventura_v8_5l0_na
source: Game engine for the Ventura GT (racing_game, docs/new_cars_plan.md Q6: 'It needs sound, give it 8 cylinders'). Not a real engine: an [AS] 1970-style naturally aspirated 90 deg cross-plane V8, two valves per cylinder, pushrod, one four-barrel-sized throttle, cast log manifolds and a dual exhaust. Bore 101.6 x stroke 76.2 mm (4.00 x 3.00 in) x 8 = 4942 cm3 [AS, the classic 302 cu in small-block geometry]; every other number is [AS]. Firing order 1-5-4-2-6-3-7-8 with banks 1-4 / 5-8 (the cross-plane small-block order): each bank fires unevenly (90/180/270 deg gaps), which is where the rumble comes from; the two banks' manifolds merge only behind 600 mm bank pipes. The throttle is electronic in the model (the game's auto-blip needs one), a carburettor is not modelled. ECU: MBT tracking limited by the generated knock limit on E5 with a 2 deg margin (ignition_strategy knock_limited), stoichiometric part load, lambda 0.86 at full load. Measured with ps::drivetrain::run_dyno_sweep (wide-open throttle, warm, default installation, 2026-10-13): peak torque 470.1 N*m at 4250 rpm, peak power 234.1 kW at 5250 rpm.

lambda_target.source: [AS] stoichiometric part load, power enrichment at wide-open throttle (lambda 0.86)

cycle.source: [AS] two valves per cylinder: 49 mm intake / 39 mm exhaust, 256 deg duration, 10.4 / 10.0 mm lift, IVO 18 BTDC / IVC 58 ABDC / EVO 72 BBDC / EVC 4 ATDC (a mild 1970s cam, 22 deg overlap); compression 9.0:1 for 1970s fuel; 380 mm runners into a 4 L plenum, 450 mm primaries into one log per bank, 600 mm bank pipes joined at the flange. Assumed, not measured.

intake.source: [AS] 80 mm equivalent throttle (four-barrel class), 4 L plenum, 380 mm runners 48 -> 44 mm.

exhaust.source: [AS] cast log manifold per bank: 450 mm x 42 mm primaries into a 600 mm x 55 mm bank pipe; both banks join in a 250 mm x 70 mm Y at the flange.

mass_source: ASSUMED [AS]: a cast-iron 5 L two-valve pushrod V8 with intake and exhaust manifolds weighs 200-230 kg (recalled for the period small-blocks, no citation fetched).
